name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - § 6 - Am 114
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 6. Notes that the estimated liquidity-management costs for NGEU amount to EUR 350 million in 2027 and requests that those costs be presented on a separate budget line in order to ensure transparency; stresses that such a reclassification does not constitute a saving or justify expenditure above the MFF ceilings; rejects the financing of those costs through the EURI Instrument and insists that any legally unavoidable costs be covered through savings and redeployment within the existing budget;
